disagreements.judge_why: The 15-day document submission deadline from passage [1] is supported as current because passages [2] through [5] contain no amendments altering the reimbursement window established in PW-HEALTH-002.
The summary is supported by passage [1], which permits pre-authorisation for planned admissions at a network hospital.

The summary supports a PAYABLE position for a second own damage claim under No Claim Bonus Protection, but passage [1] explicitly states that a second or subsequent claim in the same policy year results in the No Claim Bonus reverting to nil.

The summary concludes the claim is PAYABLE while citing facts establishing that it is the third nil depreciation claim and therefore subject to the depreciation table under passage [1], contradicting the position.

verdicts.why: The summary correctly applies the INR 3,000 compulsory deductible for vehicles above 1500cc supported by endorsement [2] which explicitly supersedes the base policy [1].
The summary correctly applies the 10% co-payment percentage supported by passage [1] for an insured person aged 67 exceeding the threshold of 66 years.
The 15-day document submission deadline from passage [1] is supported as current because passages [2] through [5] contain no amendments altering the reimbursement window established in PW-HEALTH-002.
The summary correctly applies the exclusion for treatment outside India under passage [1], which is confirmed as unchanged by passage [2] for claim CLM-2026-00567.

The summary concludes the claim is PAYABLE [1], but passage [1] states that nil depreciation does not extend to tyres and tubes on which 50% depreciation applies, while the claim file involves only tyre damage with no other part damaged, leaving no basis for full coverage under the policy passages.
The summary correctly relies on passage [1] to support the pro-rata refund position for an annual policy cancelled with no claims made.
The summary correctly relies on passages [1] and [4] which list items such as hand wash, shoe covers, and attendant charges as non-payable or subsumed items matching the claim file incident.
The summary is supported by passage [1], which permits pre-authorisation for planned admissions at a network hospital.
The summary's position that admission expenses for diagnostics and evaluation are excluded is fully supported by passage [1].

The summary supports a PAYABLE position by citing a proportionate deduction exception in passage [1], but nothing in the claim file establishes the precondition that the hospital does not follow differential billings or that differential billing was not adopted based on the room category.

The summary supports a PAYABLE position for a second own damage claim under No Claim Bonus Protection, but passage [1] explicitly states that a second or subsequent claim in the same policy year results in the No Claim Bonus reverting to nil.
The summary correctly applies the 30-day intimation requirement from passage [1], and because the birth was intimated after 37 days, the newborn cover is correctly denied.

The summary concludes the claim is PAYABLE while citing facts establishing that it is the third nil depreciation claim and therefore subject to the depreciation table under passage [1], contradicting the position.

The summary refers the claim based on the condition that road ambulance expenses are payable only when certified by a Medical Practitioner and accepted under in-patient hospitalization [1], which correctly reflects the policy passages.
The summary correctly states that the claim is referred to the Special Investigation Unit because it was flagged for investigation by the fraud unit, as supported by passage [2].

The summary correctly establishes that cataract surgery is a payable day care procedure under passage [1], which is not contradicted by any endorsement regarding waiting periods or sub-limits for standard day care cataract procedures.
The summary correctly observes that none of the retrieved passages [1], [2], [3], [4], [5] contain an exclusion for alcohol consumption or intoxication for claim CLM-2026-00509.
The summary correctly takes a referred position and states that the provided endorsement [4] does not contain the specific intimation deadline for the motor claim.

The summary claims that cover commenced on 2025-09-01 and the date of loss is 2026-08-01, meaning the 12-month waiting period has been satisfied, but an elapsed time of 11 months does not satisfy a 12-month waiting period.
The summary correctly outlines the coverage from passage [4] and the reimbursement window from passage [1] in response to an open-ended inquiry about policy terms.
For claim CLM-2026-00526, the pre-authorisation requirement is supported by passages [1] and [2].
For claim CLM-2026-00533, the summary's referred position is supported by passage [3], which establishes that Endorsement END-2026-02 amends PW-HEALTH-002 and prevails where it conflicts.
The summary correctly relies on passages [3], [2], and [1] to support the coverage position for an arthrotomy of the hip joint performed with a stay under 24 hours.
The summary correctly supports the position that balloon sinuplasty is an eligible modern treatment covered up to the In-Patient Hospitalization Treatment Sum Insured using passage [1].
The summary correctly identifies that baby charges, cradle charges, and room fresheners are listed as items subsumed into room charges under Section E supported by passage [1].
